name: typeflux-mcp
description: Model Context Protocol server for Typeflux: docs, examples, JSON-Schemas, and live governance reads (bundle, catalog, validate, topology, meta, ...), a capability-gated, confirmation-hinted OPERATE tier (start with schema-validated input + elicitation, subscribable status, review, cancel, repin, refresh), guided /typeflux:* recipes with live-project ID completions, and local authoring aids (scaffold_ai_activity/workflow/project + doctor) that return reviewable-diff content — over stdio or a bearer-authed, per-session-isolated Streamable-HTTP transport, with zero-config managed-local discovery. Makes a coding agent fluent in — and able to operate and author — a Typeflux project.

scripts.prebuild: npm run generate:schemas && npm run generate:assets && npm run typecheck
